svg.aria-label: Esposas Literárias: A book club platform with over 400 readers. A Cloudflare Worker on D1, and three apps that consume it: native iPhone, native Android and the web app. homelab: A single Proxmox node, all in Git: OpenShift SNO, Kafka, GPU passthrough, VLANs and GitOps. If a machine can't be rebuilt from the repo, it doesn't count. Red Hat · AD221 · DO288 · DO180: Cloud-native integration with Red Hat Fuse, plus the apps from the OpenShift courses.
